title: Nocturne's four kit emails (note, welcome, dates, receipt) from its design system, in the stock catalog
detail: Nocturne (code id midnight) was the only kit theme without its own four kit emails; Temple, Designer, Network, New World and Services each had a pure module wired into lib/email-samples/catalog.ts. The Nocturne handoff's ui_kits/products/EmailPage.html already carries the four letters (renderLetter: note, welcome, dates, receipt as tables with inline styles), so this was code, not a missing design. lib/theme/nocturne-kit-email.ts builds them the way temple-kit-email.ts does: nested tables, inline styles and bgcolor, the letter's own night palette (INK #0E0C14, CARD #17141F, BONE #F1ECE2, MUTED #B8B1A6, HAIR #2A2633, none of which is in MIDNIGHT_PALETTE, so each carries token-ok), the desk from MIDNIGHT_PALETTE.black100, the kit profile's accent, display face and corners from NOCTURNE_KITS, Helvetica body, and the italic accent word (upright on an upright kit). The design's welcome promised one letter most weeks; that line is dropped for the voice guide. The catalog carries nocturne-kit-note, -welcome, -dates and -receipt for one fixture house in the general kit. Probe: node scripts/probes/nocturne-kit-email.mjs.
